description: Layered networking architecture: OSI & TCP/IP models, physical media, data link ARQ, IP routing, TCP/UDP transport, and application protocols.

topics.title: Network Topologies, LAN, MAN, WAN and Transmission Media
topics.description: Star, bus, ring, mesh topologies; LAN vs WAN scopes; guided (twisted pair, coax, fiber) vs unguided media.
subtopics: Guided transmission media (UTP, STP, Fiber Optic)

topics.title: 7 Layers of OSI Model and Encapsulation/Decapsulation
topics.description: ISO/OSI reference model: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application; header encapsulation.
subtopics: Protocol Data Units (Bits, Frames, Packets, Segments)
Service Access Points (SAPs) and peer-to-peer communication

topics.title: TCP/IP Architecture and Comparison with OSI Model
topics.description: 4-layer DoD TCP/IP model (Network Access, Internet, Transport, Application) and architectural differences from OSI.
subtopics: Core protocols overview (IP, TCP, UDP, ARP, ICMP)

topics.title: Signals, Bandwidth, Latency, Nyquist and Shannon Theorems
topics.description: Analog vs digital transmission, propagation delay, transmission delay, Nyquist noiseless limit, and Shannon noisy channel capacity.
subtopics: Nyquist Bit Rate formula C = 2B log2(V)
Shannon Capacity theorem C = B log2(1 + SNR)

topics.title: Framing Methods, Parity, Checksum and CRC
topics.description: Bit/byte stuffing, framing boundaries, error detection: parity checks, internet checksum, and Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC).

topics.title: Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N and Selective Repeat ARQ
topics.description: Sliding window protocol, Stop-and-Wait ARQ, Go-Back-N (cumulative ACKs), and Selective Repeat (individual ACKs).
subtopics: Sliding window concept and bandwidth-delay product
Selective Repeat buffers and independent acknowledgments

topics.title: ALOHA, CSMA/CD, CSMA/CA and Ethernet Standards
topics.description: Multiple Access Control: Pure/Slotted ALOHA, Carrier Sense Multiple Access (CSMA), CSMA/CD (Ethernet), CSMA/CA (Wi-Fi), and MAC addresses.
subtopics: Pure ALOHA vs Slotted ALOHA maximum efficiency
CSMA/CD collision detection and binary exponential backoff

topics.title: IPv4 Addressing, Subnetting, CIDR and Address Classes
topics.description: 32-bit IPv4 structure, Classful addressing (A, B, C, D, E), Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR), and subnet masks.
subtopics: Classful addressing boundaries and network/host bits
CIDR slash notation (e.g. /24) and route summarization

topics.title: IPv6 Format, Dual-Stack and IPv4 vs IPv6 Comparison
topics.description: 128-bit IPv6 addressing, hexadecimal representation, address simplification rules, unicast/multicast/anycast, and transition strategies.
subtopics: Omission of leading zeros and :: zero compression

topics.title: Distance Vector Routing, Link State Routing and RIP/OSPF
topics.description: Shortest path routing: Bellman-Ford (Distance Vector), Count-to-Infinity problem, Dijkstra's algorithm (Link State), and intra/inter-AS routing.

topics.title: Routers, Switches, Bridges, ARP, RARP and ICMP
topics.description: Interconnecting hardware: Hubs (L1), Switches (L2), Routers (L3); Address Resolution Protocol (ARP), and Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP).
subtopics: Switch MAC address learning and forwarding tables
ICMP error reporting, ping, and traceroute

topics.title: UDP Header, Connectionless Service and Use Cases
topics.description: User Datagram Protocol (UDP): 8-byte header, connectionless lightweight delivery, checksum, and real-time streaming/VoIP applications.

topics.title: TCP Segment, 3-Way Handshake, Connection Teardown and Reliability
topics.description: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP): byte-stream orientation, sequence/ACK numbers, 3-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK), 4-way teardown, and timers.

topics.title: Sliding Window, AIMD, Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance and Fast Recovery
topics.description: Receiver-advertised flow control (rwnd) vs network congestion control (cwnd), Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance (AIMD), Fast Retransmit.
subtopics: Fast Retransmit (3 duplicate ACKs) and Fast Recovery

topics.title: DNS Hierarchy, Record Types and DHCP DORA Process
topics.description: Domain Name System: root, TLD, authoritative servers, recursive/iterative queries; DHCP 4-step DORA process.
subtopics: DNS record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS)

topics.title: HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, Symmetric/Asymmetric Encryption, Firewalls
topics.description: Application protocols: HTTP request/response, HTTPS with SSL/TLS handshake, symmetric vs asymmetric cryptography, and firewalls.
subtopics: TLS cryptographic handshake and digital certificates
